name: Bubble
description: Bubble is a software development platform that enables anyone to build and launch web and mobile applications without writing code. Rather than specializing in one or two aspects of development (like designing landing pages or building databases), Bubble’s full-stack visual programming interface does it all. That means anyone from first-time founders to enterprises can take an idea from concept to fully functional, scalable reality — faster and cheaper than you could with just code.
label: Build and launch web and mobile apps without writing code
label_zh: 构建和发布网页和移动应用，无需编写代码
content_zh: Bubble 是一个软件开发平台，可以让任何人无需编写代码就能构建和发布网页及移动应用。与其他专注于设计着陆页或构建数据库等单一或少数几个方面的开发工具不同，Bubble 提供了全栈可视化编程界面，可以完成所有这些任务。这意味着无论是初次创业的创始人还是大型企业，都可以将一个想法从概念快速且低成本地转化为功能齐全、可扩展的应用程序。

name: Chronicle
description: Chronicle combines AI with taste to help you go from raw thoughts to polished presentations. Designed for serious work: Start with templates, create with AI workflows, and collaborate with your team to shape your ideas into impactful narratives.
label: Stunning presentations with AI. No design skills required.
label_zh: 惊人的演示文稿，由AI打造。无需设计技能。
content_zh: Chronicle 将人工智能与品味相结合，帮助你将原始想法转化为精美的演示文稿。它专为严肃的工作设计：从模板开始，使用 AI 工作流创建内容，并与团队合作，将你的想法塑造成有影响力的叙述。

name: Instance
description: Instance is an AI-powered app builder for iOS, Android, and the web that lets you create apps, games, and websites by describing them in plain English. If coding has ever slowed you down, Instance will help you bring your ideas to life.
label: From idea to app–in an Instance
label_zh: 从创意到应用——瞬间实现
topics_zh: 无代码平台、网站构建器、人工智能
content_zh: Instance 是一款基于人工智能的应用构建工具，适用于 iOS、Android 和网页平台。你只需用简单的英语描述你的想法，就能创建应用程序、游戏和网站。如果你曾经因为编码而感到困扰，Instance 可以帮助你将创意变为现实。

name: Desearch
description: Desearch is the first decentralized, real-time AI search engine for devs, founders, marketers, and researchers. Get hallucination-free results from X, Reddit, web and more via WebApp or API. Built with AI agents and builders in mind. Powered by Bittensor.
label: First Decentralized AI Search for Builders & Agents
label_zh:
首次为构建者和代理推出的去中心化AI搜索

首次为建设者和代理人打造的去中心化AI搜索
content_zh: Desearch 是首个去中心化的实时 AI 搜索引擎，专为开发者、创始人、营销人员和研究人员设计。它可以从 X、Reddit、网页等多个来源获取无误的结果，通过 Web 应用或 API 访问。该产品考虑到了 AI 代理和构建者的需求，由 Bittensor 提供支持。

name: Wegic
description:
Wegic now lets you:
1）Add integrated payments by connecting your account and start receiving funds.
2）Use conversational AI to collect user needs and leads — say hello to quality data.

And here’s a breakthrough: Wegic Ultra — your website grows automatically, powered by data.
Imagine sleeping while your site optimizes itself and drives more revenue!
This world-first innovation lets Wegic analyze visitors, spot growth opportunities, and adjust content and design — all to boost sales!
label: World’s first AI website team—turning your ideas into income
label_zh: 世界首个AI网站团队——将您的想法转化为收益
content_zh:
Wegic 现在让你可以：
1）通过连接你的账户添加集成支付功能，开始接收资金。
2）利用对话式 AI 收集用户需求和潜在客户——向高质量数据问好。

还有一个突破：Wegic Ultra —— 你的网站会自动成长，由数据驱动。
想象一下，当你的网站在你睡觉时自动优化并带来更多收入！
这项全球首创的创新技术让 Wegic 能够分析访客、发现增长机会，并调整内容和设计——所有这些都是为了提高销售额。

name: PhotoFuse
description: Turn your selfies into AI characters and generate stunning realistic photos and professional headshots of yourself just in seconds.
label: Your personal AI photographer in your pocket
content_zh: 将你的自拍照变成AI角色，几秒钟内生成令人惊艳的真实照片和专业头像。

name: nCompass Tech
description: With the nCompass AI inference platform, you get deployments with reliable uptime, custom GPU kernels for fast inference and model performance & health monitoring built for production deployments of any AI model available on HuggingFace.
label: Reliable, scalable & fast inference of any HuggingFace model
label_zh:
可靠、可扩展且快速的任何 HuggingFace 模型推理

---

可靠、可扩展并且快速地进行任何 HuggingFace 模型的推理
content_zh: 使用nCompass AI推理平台，您可以获得高可靠性的部署、定制的GPU内核以实现快速推理，以及专为生产环境中的任何HuggingFace模型设计的性能和健康监控。

name: Huntr
description:
Huntr is your all-in-one job search tool.
From building your resume to reviewing it to a quick job save to a tailored resume and cover letter, Huntr helps job seekers throughout the process of searching for their next exciting opportunity. Whether you're applying for an internship or an executive role, Huntr's AI is sophisticated and will craft a resume for you at the level you're at with the right vocabulary and keywords needed to present yourself at the level you're applying for.
label: The job search tool that automates the job search for you
label_zh: 为您自动化的求职工具
content_zh: Huntr 是你的一站式求职工具。从简历制作到审核，再到快速保存职位和定制简历及求职信，Huntr 能够帮助求职者在寻找下一个令人兴奋的机会时全程提供支持。无论你是申请实习还是高管职位，Huntr 的 AI 都非常先进，能够根据你的水平为你量身打造简历，使用合适的词汇和关键词来展示你的能力和资历。

name: Odyc.js
description: Odyc.js is a simple JavaScript library to create interactive narrative games, even without coding experience.
label: Build tiny narrative games in JS
content_zh: Odyc.js 是一个简单的 JavaScript 库，可以帮助你创建互动叙事游戏，即使没有编程经验也能轻松上手。

name: Ranklytics
description: Ranklytics helps you rank on the top page 10x faster by automating content strategy & generation using AI and providing actionable insights to help you optimize your website better. You can put your entire content marketing on auto-pilot.
label: Rank on the first page 10x faster with AI-enabled SEO.
label_zh: 使用AI赋能的SEO，以10倍速度登上首页。
content_zh: Ranklytics 利用 AI 自动化内容策略和生成，帮助你更快地将网站排名提升到首页，速度可以提高十倍。它还能提供实用的见解，帮助你更好地优化网站。你可以完全自动化你的内容营销。

name: Jina
description:
Jina is your AI QA engineer that tests apps end-to-end and catches bugs autonomously, at scale. It understands UI, code, and user intent. Doesn't rely on test scripts or CSS selectors and requires no maintenance.

She also roasts websites - https://roast.usejina.com/
label: AI QA Engineer
topics_zh: 测试与质量保证软件，AI编码助手
content_zh:
Jina 是你的 AI 质量工程师，能够全面测试应用程序并自动发现大量 bug。它理解用户界面、代码和用户意图，不需要依赖测试脚本或 CSS 选择器，也不需要维护。

此外，它还可以对网站进行评估——https://roast.usejina.com/

name: Seekeasy MCP
description: Explore Seekeasy's data with our MCP which returns recommendations for restaurants based on social media creator content. Understand the shape and trends of social media through the eyes of your favorite creators.
label: Restaurant recs powered by social media creators
label_zh: 餐厅推荐由社交媒体创作者提供支持
content_zh: 通过Seekeasy MCP，您可以探索我们的数据，并根据社交媒体创作者的内容获取餐厅推荐。透过您喜爱的创作者的视角，了解社交媒体的形态和趋势。

name: Blockies Animate
description: Blockies Animate is a lightweight React library with plug-and-play animation components. Add smooth, customizable motion to your UI in seconds — no setup hassle, fully responsive, and built for performance.
label: Smooth, plug-and-play UI animations for any modern web app
label_zh: 顺滑即插即用的界面动画，适用于任何现代网页应用
content_zh: Blockies Animate 是一个轻量级的 React 库，包含即插即用的动画组件。只需几秒钟，你就可以为用户界面添加流畅且可自定义的动画效果，无需繁琐的设置，完全响应式，并且性能出色。

name: CoffeeChat Bot
description: Keep your community alive and provide value via automated networking events in your Discord server. Automated scheduling, partner matching, and voice channel assignments.
label: Automated networking events for your Discord community
label_zh: 为您的Discord社区提供自动化的网络活动
content_zh: 在你的Discord服务器中，通过自动化的社交活动来保持社区活跃并提供价值。包括自动安排活动、匹配参与者以及分配语音频道。

name: Promina
description: Promina tracks your brand’s visibility across AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok and Perplexity. Get insights, fix content gaps, and win top answer spots with AEO (Answer Engine Optimization). Try it for 2 months with the Product Hunt coupon PH2025
label: If AI is the new Google, are you the answer?
label_zh: 如果AI是新的谷歌，那你就是答案吗？
content_zh: Promina 能追踪你的品牌在 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Grok 和 Perplexity 等 AI 工具中的曝光情况。通过它，你可以获取洞察、填补内容空缺，并通过答案引擎优化（AEO）赢得最佳答案位置。使用 Product Hunt 优惠码 PH2025 可以免费试用两个月。
